name: who-gho-mcp-server
description: Query WHO Global Health Observatory data — 3,102 indicators across 194 member states with country, region, year, and sex filters via MCP. STDIO or Streamable HTTP.

interface.shortDescription: Query WHO Global Health Observatory data — 3,102 indicators across 194 member states with country, region, year, and sex filters.
interface.longDescription: WHO Global Health Observatory MCP server providing access to 3,102 health indicators across 194 WHO member states. Supports WHO country codes including historical codes, WHO regions, World Bank income groups, year ranges, sex, and positional dimension 1/2/3 filters. Primary workflow: search indicators → get metadata → query data.
